# Interferon response summary

Differential expression analysis revealed coordinated activation of the type-I interferon program. IFI6 was strongly upregulated (Table 1). ISG15 was upregulated in the treated arm (Table 1). MX1 was upregulated in IFN-treated PBMCs (Table 1). OAS1 was upregulated as part of the canonical ISG cluster (Table 1). IFI44 was upregulated alongside the other interferon-stimulated genes (Table 1). STAT1 was upregulated as expected for a JAK-STAT signaling response (Table 1).

In contrast, the proinflammatory cytokines TNF and IL6 were downregulated (Table 1). No further claims are made about the remaining catalogue.
